meta.note: A debugging agent that keeps the entire system in check, wrapped into a brain.

debugging_agent.role: System integrity. Not a 43rd ring agent — it sits at the center and watches everything.
checks_slow_tick: inspection contracts complete (id/type/state/source/evidence/role) on all entities
mechanics alive: fluid levels moving, quanta updating, drift accumulating, currents diffusing
Archive budget within 15MB cap; no silent drops
zero console errors; no broken assets
debugging_agent.on_fault: Logs a health holding to the Archive (first-class, against budget), proposes a fix as PROPOSAL_ONLY through the normal approval gate. Critical faults surface to Nathan directly.

brain.desc: The central coordination layer the debugging agent runs in — the system's brain.
brain.panel: A system-health drawer: per-subsystem status (planets, agents, Archive, engine loop), thermo vitals, intelligence metric slope, recent anomalies, proposed fixes awaiting approval.
brain.position: At the center of the system, observing all — the nucleus to the 42 agents' ring. Fits the organism framing: the brain guards coherence.

maintainers: Watchdog (pressure: load guard, FAIL_SAFE throttle) — Nathan's own background process
Mira (meaning: identity, memory, translation, recovery; her Gate facet runs the approval gate) — Nathan's strong agent
MATER (integrity: SHA-256 hashing, Ed25519 signing, tamper-evident audit log) — the eagle of BUBO OS
